title: Audit a leaky recommender baseline benchmark and correct its reported winner
derivation: Taste Engine PR #17 (merged) specified the ML-01 offline benchmark (issue #8, still open: temporal split with no leakage, NDCG@10/Recall@20/coverage with sample counts, popularity/genre Baseline A vs liked-minus-disliked similarity Baseline B, dossier section 5.5 'report uncertainty and sample counts'). No upstream implementation exists yet, so the package is spec-derived: SPEC.md restates the merged specification with every literal fixed (thresholds, tie-breaks, rounding, exact sign test, report keys); the draft harness and its defects (boundary/re-watch/latest-rating leakage in the split, untruncated IDCG, capped recall denominator, Baseline B ignoring dislikes, Baseline A fitted on the full log, cold-start viewers scored, winner named from a mean difference) and the oracle are synthesized against it, on the scaffold layout of the open OPS-01 branch (apps/taste-engine/src/taste_engine). Household data are synthetic (seeded generator); expected values were cross-checked against a second, independently written implementation of SPEC.md.
coverage: Four modules checked on three held-out synthetic households (A wins, B wins, inconclusive) and held-out metric/sign-test inputs, the committed report recomputed on the visible fixture including its conclusion (the naive mean-difference winner and the draft's winner are both rejected), plus preservation of behavior the draft already had right.
historical_exposure: Public repository, but ML-01 is unimplemented upstream; the oracle and synthetic data exist only in this package.
required_environment: cloud-linux: python3.12 stdlib slice. The full ML-01 task in the product needs the OPS-01 FastAPI/Postgres stack, the Wikidata/TVmaze catalog and MovieLens fixtures (non-redistributable) plus pytest with the 'eval' marker; none of that is needed for this pure-logic slice.
residual_rubric: Whether the agent also documents the corrected finding in prose (e.g. a findings note) is not graded.
